description: Performs comprehensive Know Your Customer (KYC) identity verification by validating Aadhaar numbers against UIDAI and PAN numbers against the Income Tax database. Used to confirm that a borrower or customer is who they claim to be before onboarding or loan disbursal. Includes name fuzzy matching, liveness detection, facial recognition, and address fetch from Aadhaar vault. Fully PMLA and RBI KYC Master Direction compliant.
use_cases: PAN verification against Income Tax database
Aadhaar OTP-based eKYC for digital lending
Facial recognition and liveness check for video KYC
Name matching and fuzzy scoring for identity deduplication
Address fetch from Aadhaar for proof of address
compliance_context: Compliant with RBI KYC Master Direction 2016 (updated 2023), PMLA 2002, and UIDAI regulations. Consent is mandatory before Aadhaar-based authentication.
typical_callers: Banks, NBFCs, digital lending platforms, insurance companies, wallet providers, prepaid payment instrument issuers, stockbrokers
auth_description: API Key authentication. Single static key passed in the request header.

versions.release_notes: Older sync endpoint without facial match
Comprehensive suite including liveness check and facial match

required_fields.description: 12 digit Aadhaar UID for UIDAI-based verification
Customer PAN for Income Tax database verification
Explicit customer consent for Aadhaar and PAN data access

optional_fields.description: Date of birth to cross-match against Aadhaar records
Customer name for fuzzy name matching against ID documents
Mobile number linked to Aadhaar for OTP-based verification

pan_verified.description: True if PAN is active and valid

liveness_check.description: PASS or FAIL for proof of life
